title: security: enforce OAuth callback state lifecycle and replay protection
description: Implement one-time-use OAuth state store (memory or DB-backed), strictly bind state at challenge and consume+invalidate on callback; add tests for replay prevention and expired-state rejection.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Audit synthesis corroboration: the redacted audit confirms OAuth callback state needs one-time binding, expiry, and replay protection. This is the lifecycle portion of the bridge finding and remains covered here.
